title: The future of large-scale experiments and their challenges in the digital era
title_zh: 大规模实验的未来及其在数字时代的挑战
abstract: Large-scale randomized experiments involving millions of observations have transformed social science across academic and applied domains. These methods are now widely used in fields ranging from economics and political science to public health, education and digital product development. Drawing on the experience of industry practitioners and academic collaborators, this Perspective outlines six areas where the expanding scale and scope of experimental studies have introduced new challenges. We describe open problems related to organizational incentives and experimental governance; privacy, fairness and ethics; long-term impact estimation; time-adaptive experimental studies; heterogeneous treatment effects; and generative artificial intelligence. For each area, we summarize recent methodological advances, highlight ongoing limitations and suggest directions for future work. Our goal is to surface practical challenges that merit greater attention from the research community and to encourage sustained collaboration between academics and practitioners in shaping the future of experimental studies. Large-scale experiments now underpin much of modern social science. This Perspective highlights six emerging challenges and suggests directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 涉及数百万次观测的大规模随机实验已在学术和应用领域转型了社会科学。这些方法如今在经济学、政治学、公共卫生、教育和数字产品开发等领域得到广泛应用。基于行业从业者和学术合作者的经验，本文从六个方面展望了大规模实验规模和范围扩大所带来的新挑战。我们描述了与组织激励和实验治理、隐私、公平与伦理、长期影响估计、自适应实验研究、异质性治疗效应以及生成式人工智能相关的公开问题。针对每个领域，我们总结了近期的方法论进展，指出了持续的局限性，并提出了未来的研究方向。我们的目的是凸显值得研究界更多关注的实际挑战，并鼓励学术界与产业界在塑造实验研究的未来方面进行持续合作。大规模实验如今支撑了现代社会科学的很大一部分。本文综述了六大新兴挑战并提出了未来的研究方向。
